entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Please come this way. Ewald and I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please come this way. Ewald and I have some exciting news to share with you."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“The corruption in that organizatio..."
entries.dialogueText: “The corruption in that organization is unfathomable. Makes the Lotherberg group look like saints.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“By the way, I still don't believe..."
entries.dialogueText: “By the way, I still don't believe Taurus should be trusted with such a monumental mega-project.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I'm glad you contracted Underhall,..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm glad you contracted Underhall, by the way. You won't be disappointed.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The government has clear control o..."
entries.dialogueText: “The government has clear control over SSC's operations. We wouldn't get that with a private corporation.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I have to take the safe option thi..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have to take the safe option this early in the term, Mr. Manger.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I think it's time we let fresh --..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think it's time we let fresh -- and fast -- new faces have a shot.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Status quos are meant to be broken..."
entries.dialogueText: “Status quos are meant to be broken. I want to be the change maker during my term.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It seemed the least risky option...."
entries.dialogueText: “It seemed the least risky option. We need safe bets.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The workers need to be protected s..."
entries.dialogueText: “The workers need to be protected somehow. We can't ignore that problem.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“It might seem like we have control..."
entries.dialogueText: “It might seem like we have control, but those organizations are slow and inflexible.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I admit I'm slightly frustrated th..."
entries.dialogueText: “I admit I'm slightly frustrated that you contracted SSC. They've been leeching off the Sordish people for too long.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“They need to walk before they can..."
entries.dialogueText: “They need to walk before they can run. And I'm saying this as a guy who actually almost likes Frens Ricter."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Calculated risks, Mr. President. T..."
entries.dialogueText: “Calculated risks, Mr. President. Taurus is not the right call. But don't mind me."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“It's a pity you only had three cho..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's a pity you only had three choices, to be honest.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The SSC is one of our national tre..."
entries.dialogueText: “The SSC is one of our national treasures. It rebuilt most of Sordland in the '30s.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Understandable. But we have to bre..."
entries.dialogueText: “Understandable. But we have to break the cycle at some point if we want to stick around.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Yes, nobody can deny the SSC's gre..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, nobody can deny the SSC's great work for our people in the Restoration period. But those days are long gone.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pushed open a door. We walked do..."
entries.dialogueText: He pushed open a door. We walked down yet another hallway, seemingly in the direction we'd just come from.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Like a maze, isn't it? That's Qina..."
entries.dialogueText: “Like a maze, isn't it? That's Qinali architecture for you."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“The only difference between an SSC..."
entries.dialogueText: “The only difference between an SSC manager and a fossil from the pre-Migration period is that the fossil might actually be worth something.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A stark contrast to the blue-collar..."
entries.dialogueText: A stark contrast to the blue-collar workers outside working with machinery, transportation, and maintenance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The doors opened."
entries.dialogueText: The doors opened.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“To be 100 percent honest, Mr. Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: “To be 100 percent honest, Mr. President, I doubted he even wanted to discuss this with you.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“We do have to be delicate with Gas..."
entries.dialogueText: “We do have to be delicate with Gasom, though. A corporation this big is like a house of cards."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“He must really care about Gasom.”"
entries.dialogueText: “He must really care about Gasom.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Does the average working-class man..."
entries.dialogueText: “Does the average working-class man in Narbel really give a damn about that?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We won't know until they complete..."
entries.dialogueText: “We won't know until they complete the project. There's no reason to be negative before then.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I respect that. Most of my life ha..."
entries.dialogueText: “I respect that. Most of my life has been about changing the status quo in Gruni.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Time will tell. I also hope that i..."
entries.dialogueText: “Time will tell. I also hope that it will succeed, believe me.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I still have my doubts, but I'll t..."
entries.dialogueText: “I still have my doubts, but I'll take your word for now.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I'm just a civil servant who wants..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm just a civil servant who wants what's best for the Sordish people.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“But there's a time and a place to..."
entries.dialogueText: “But there's a time and a place to take risks. The stock market, yes. National infrastructure, no.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Admittedly, I'm biased. But I do t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Admittedly, I'm biased. But I do think Gasom is extraordinary.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We worked closely in the past and..."
entries.dialogueText: “We worked closely in the past and are on friendly terms. I'm open to see what we can do.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I think he is fully focused on Gas..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think he is fully focused on Gasom these days. His entire reputation is bound to this corporation now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What's in the past shouldn't shape..."
entries.dialogueText: “What's in the past shouldn't shape our future. Especially if a good deal can be talked through.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The feeling is mutual. Both of us..."
entries.dialogueText: “The feeling is mutual. Both of us are only here because of you, Gus.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“It's one of Sordland's most signif..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's one of Sordland's most significant private corporations. Ewald's reputation as chairman and ex-CEO rests on it.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Yes, and Sordland needs any deal i..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, and Sordland needs any deal it can get. Soon the term budget will be determined and expenditures won't recover the economy.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I do my best. Got a close influent..."
entries.dialogueText: “I do my best. Got a close influential contact in Porte Drazon who opened a lot of doors a few years ago.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Moreover, we have an opportunity t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Moreover, we have an opportunity to make a larger economic impact on the people of Narbel.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“We can't provide services to our p..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can't provide services to our people without corporations like Gasom filling our coffers."

entries.title: Player: "“I wasn't against him early on. Qui..."
entries.dialogueText: “I wasn't against him early on. Quite the opposite.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""I still remember the day the party..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still remember the day the party leadership changed from Tarquin Soll. What a historic moment that was.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Shall we?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Shall we?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The fact that you managed to get R..."
entries.dialogueText: “The fact that you managed to get Rizia entangled in this is surprising.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“If he needs to be hands-on as chai..."
entries.dialogueText: “If he needs to be hands-on as chairman, then the business must not be doing well.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What's so extraordinary about anot..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's so extraordinary about another corporation trying to make a hefty profit off the back of the people?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I have no ill-will against Ewald A..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have no ill-will against Ewald Alphonso.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Human greed is undeniable. I alway..."
entries.dialogueText: “Human greed is undeniable. I always saw it as an asset to move wealth our way, to Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“It's true that it's seen a lack of..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's true that it's seen a lack of consistent growth.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“As you know, he and I go back a lo..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you know, he and I go back a long time. He isn't the sell-out some Sollists painted him to be.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Why should you?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Why should you?”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“But Gasom is beyond that. Not many..."
entries.dialogueText: “But Gasom is beyond that. Not many nations have such an influential and valuable asset. We ought to maximize its potential.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“But Gasom has the potential to riv..."
entries.dialogueText: “But Gasom has the potential to rival global corporations like Rizian Royal Gold. It could be *the* gas exporter."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Not exactly the most pleasant loca..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not exactly the most pleasant location for a meeting, is it?"

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""I trust Ministers Walda and Beniwo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust Ministers Walda and Beniwoll didn't overwhelm you with their demands."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good to see you, Gus. I wanted to..."
entries.dialogueText: “Good to see you, Gus. I wanted to talk to you about what we can do to help the development here.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I would be surprised if there are..."
entries.dialogueText: “I would be surprised if there are no demands or expectations here today.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's a relief to have a break from..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a relief to have a break from all that, even if just for a little while."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Petr Vectern isn't the only one yo..."
entries.dialogueText: “Petr Vectern isn't the only one you can have fun with, you know! Jokes aside, you are the President, so do what you want!”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“No demands from me, President Rayn..."
entries.dialogueText: “No demands from me, President Rayne. I'm all about making deals and finding common ground.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Perfect. That's exactly what I hop..."
entries.dialogueText: “Perfect. That's exactly what I hope to accomplish during today's discussions. My job is to improve the conditions of places like these.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Sipping Borin wine at the Jewel be..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sipping Borin wine at the Jewel beach resort in Benfi would be better, yes.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Except for running the country to..."
entries.dialogueText: “Except for running the country to the ground, please.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“If there's one thing Gus Manger st..."
entries.dialogueText: “If there's one thing Gus Manger stands for, it's win-win solutions.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“The methods for achieving better l..."
entries.dialogueText: “The methods for achieving better living standards can be discussed in detail when we talk terms.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""But you know, as someone who has n..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you know, as someone who has never experienced the working-class way of life, it's important for me to understand why my role holds such significance."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Kris Schar and the company still h..."
entries.dialogueText: “Kris Schar and the company still have many things they need to figure out, but they are good at what they do.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“We won't ignore it, Mr. President...."
entries.dialogueText: “We won't ignore it, Mr. President. But as I mentioned before, I don't think this new Assembly bill is the way.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Too few large corporations own too..."
entries.dialogueText: “Too few large corporations own too much power. Market economics won't succeed with monopolies.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“If I had any extra time or resourc..."
entries.dialogueText: “If I had any extra time or resources left, I'd enter the construction business myself.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Anyway, I digress. Let's get to th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Anyway, I digress. Let's get to the elevator.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Keep up with the times. Your knowl..."
entries.dialogueText: “Keep up with the times. Your knowledge will come in handy.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm still not sure how fattening y..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm still not sure how fattening your own wallet helps our rural populations."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That's going to be me one day.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That's going to be me one day.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't care about the books. My w..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't care about the books. My worry is our duty and service.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Does it, though?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Does it, though?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I see your point, but the economy..."
entries.dialogueText: “I see your point, but the economy is a complex beast.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“We can discuss this later, Mr. Ray..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can discuss this later, Mr. Rayne. We shouldn't keep our former president waiting.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“They don't, but it affects them no..."
entries.dialogueText: “They don't, but it affects them nonetheless.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Of course it wasn't just Rizia. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course it wasn't just Rizia. But their contribution led to interest from other nations like Qinal and Lespia.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I understand. Support the business..."
entries.dialogueText: “I understand. Support the business, and we support the economy.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I highly advise us to find a middl..."
entries.dialogueText: “I highly advise us to find a middle-ground. If the state can assist Gasom through these tough times, we'll all benefit."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Isn't that paraphrasing Malenyev?..."
entries.dialogueText: “Isn't that paraphrasing Malenyev? Keep in mind we only have a single term to work with.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Our country needs steadiness and s..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our country needs steadiness and stability more than ever. Yes, we need to fix inequality. But not at the expense of everything else.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Think of Gasom as a house of cards..."
entries.dialogueText: “Think of Gasom as a house of cards with an entire city built atop it."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“And none of the average citizens h..."
entries.dialogueText: “And none of the average citizens here care about anything other than direct support.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Why are there so many workers from..."
entries.dialogueText: “Why are there so many workers from abroad?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The whole complex feels very hands..."
entries.dialogueText: “The whole complex feels very hands-on deck. I can tell an intricate operation when I see one.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“It took decades for Ewald -- and t..."
entries.dialogueText: “It took decades for Ewald -- and the workers, of course -- to create an enterprise of such global competitive potential.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“The best talent in Sordland was sn..."
entries.dialogueText: “The best talent in Sordland was snatched by the SSC in the 1930s. Most other corporations couldn't contend, so they had to look elsewhere."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“The equipment provided is high-sta..."
entries.dialogueText: “The equipment provided is high-standard. I've seen it for myself. Besides, there will always be differences between workers.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The white-collars seem to be havin..."
entries.dialogueText: “The white-collars seem to be having it good in here while the majority are working out in the cold.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Ah, here's the elevator. Ewald oug..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ah, here's the elevator. Ewald ought to be up there already; there's a separate entrance by the helipad."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Pat yourself on the back, Gus. You..."
entries.dialogueText: “Pat yourself on the back, Gus. You did well. I expect the same and more in my term.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“That's what I liked about Ewald Al..."
entries.dialogueText: “That's what I liked about Ewald Alphonso. He didn't let titles or rules get in the way of results.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“It was more complicated than that...."
entries.dialogueText: “It was more complicated than that. Obstructionists in the institutions halted critical policies that could have avoided us the recession.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“It's a hundred percent with me. I..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's a hundred percent with me. I have some new ideas I'm discussing with Mr. Holl.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I'm glad we have overcome the wors..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm glad we have overcome the worst of those days. The economy isn't great, but it is more stable."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Good leadership is allowing people..."
entries.dialogueText: “Good leadership is allowing people to excel in what they are good at, not forcing them.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Yes, the privatization and the can..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, the privatization and the cancellation of old policies was too fast and radical, but that wasn't it. The geopolitical pressures on the market were significant.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“We'll brief you on those later.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We'll brief you on those later.”

entries.dialogueText: “Just remember. Past is past. We've got to look to the future."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Let's do this.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's do this.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We stepped into the elevator. Gus p..."
entries.dialogueText: We stepped into the elevator. Gus punched a code and we began our ascent.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The hallways were lined with doors...."
entries.dialogueText: The hallways were lined with doors. Glass panels in them revealed workers in suits and ties, many of foreign origin, busy in their pristine offices.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“A Qinali architect is an odd choic..."
entries.dialogueText: “A Qinali architect is an odd choice.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Some of Gasom's global hires are f..."
entries.dialogueText: “Some of Gasom's global hires are from the Republic of Qinal. Once you get past the cultural differences, they're really quite gifted.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Just remember. Alphonso's our frie..."
entries.dialogueText: “Just remember. Alphonso's our friend. We've got the foundation for a great deal.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""I have faith that you won't leave..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have faith that you won't leave us hanging."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“After your convincing arguments ab..."
entries.dialogueText: “After your convincing arguments about the railway project, I was curious what else we could achieve."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Sometimes I do it for myself, othe..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sometimes I do it for myself, other times I chase luck with others.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“For your sake and mine, I hope you..."
entries.dialogueText: “For your sake and mine, I hope you're right."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Don't you think it's a little wron..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't you think it's a little wrong that someone in your position is active in the stock market?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“A true capitalist knows how and wh..."
entries.dialogueText: “A true capitalist knows how and when to play.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I like the all-in 3000-share purch..."
entries.dialogueText: “I like the all-in 3000-share purchase you made. Shows that you're a man of action, like me."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""You played it safe with 2000 share..."
entries.dialogueText: "You played it safe with 2000 shares, but you still stand to make some gains.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Your measly 1000 shares won't make..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your measly 1000 shares won't make you much profit. But you know, good to dip your feet in the water before taking a dive.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Me, I got 4000 shares thanks to a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Me, I got 4000 shares thanks to a low-risk loan I leveraged on an old logistics business of mine.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“The offerings on the Lachaven Stoc..."
entries.dialogueText: “The offerings on the Lachaven Stock Exchange aren't bad either. Much better than anything in eastern Merkopa.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“How a development minister came to..."
entries.dialogueText: “How a development minister came to lead such initiatives is beyond me.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Alphonso was the one who nearly br..."
entries.dialogueText: “Alphonso was the one who nearly brought the depression on us in the first place.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We shouldn't act in a way that jeo..."
entries.dialogueText: “We shouldn't act in a way that jeopardizes Gasom. But we should still do *something*”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sometimes we must destroy our rott..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sometimes we must destroy our rotten foundations to build something better.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I doubt that a single regional pow..."
entries.dialogueText: “I doubt that a single regional power like Rizia had such an impact.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Look at us, promoting a planned ec..."
entries.dialogueText: “Look at us, promoting a planned economy while playing our personal wealth for profit in Arcasia.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“You make one wrong move, and the w..."
entries.dialogueText: “You make one wrong move, and the whole thing falls apart."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“We made history with the 1950 and..."
entries.dialogueText: “We made history with the 1950 and 1953 deals. You might remember that the latter agreement prevented a depression just eight months before the elections.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I hate to brag, but I was the one..."
entries.dialogueText: “I hate to brag, but I was the one who opened the gates in Porte Drazon after nearly 32 years of frozen Sordish-Rizia relations.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Rizia and Sordland were considerin..."
entries.dialogueText: “Rizia and Sordland were considering a full embargo until Alphonso and I came along."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Ah! I'm flattered, Mr. President...."
entries.dialogueText: “Ah! I'm flattered, Mr. President. And glad that you made the right choice, of course.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I haven't seen him since the inaug..."
entries.dialogueText: “I haven't seen him since the inauguration. He really pulled back from public life.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm here because something needs t..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm here because something needs to be done about Narbel's living standards.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Can you blame the guy? We went ful..."
entries.dialogueText: “Can you blame the guy? We went full Dwight Walker on him. At least we didn't resort to corporate assassinations.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Of course. That's going to play a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course. That's going to play a big role in our discussion.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""As soon as the IPO kicks in on the..."
entries.dialogueText: "As soon as the IPO kicks in on the Ventrie City Stock Exchange, we'll both be rolling in Ren."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's play, then.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's play, then.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Time for Sordland to think outside..."
entries.dialogueText: “Time for Sordland to think outside of the box and break the game.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Except the Perla exchange in Lespi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Except the Perla exchange in Lespia, of course."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Not all of the market economy beli..."
entries.dialogueText: “Not all of the market economy believers are *capitalist pigs*. Look at me, and how many jobs I've brought to this country.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I don't think so. My job is to bri..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't think so. My job is to bring resources to long-forgotten areas of Sordland and keep our rural areas vitalized.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“What I do during my personal time..."
entries.dialogueText: “What I do during my personal time doesn't affect that. If anything, keeping up with market trends will help me benefit our local economies.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Anyway, Mr. President, when it com..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anyway, Mr. President, when it comes to money, we either play the game or the game plays us.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Attract money, invest in the right..."
entries.dialogueText: “Attract money, invest in the right solutions, increase wealth and living standards. It all trickles down.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Think of history. Leaders who took..."
entries.dialogueText: “Think of history. Leaders who took big leaps were written in the books.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Well said! The higher you rise, th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well said! The higher you rise, the less you can fall. Why not pick good people up along the way?”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Well a quarter of my net wealth is..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well a quarter of my net wealth is on that stock now. But hey, you've got to play big to win big."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Here we are! Ewald, my friend.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Here we are! Ewald, my friend.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Mr. President, I've been brainstor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I've been brainstorming a little something. The Gruni Rural Investment Plan. I reckon it's got the potential to breathe new life into our rural communities out in Gruni."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""We could consider a few things. Fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could consider a few things. For starters, we could give the farming business a boost with some subsidies. Or, we could steer towards modernizing existing farms with machinery and tech."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Mr. President, I get the appeal of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I get the appeal of that GREEN bill that's been making the rounds in the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I have my doubts, Gus. But I'll gi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have my doubts, Gus. But I'll give your plan some thought."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's a tough call, Gus. I need to..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a tough call, Gus. I need to weigh the environmental implications and the economic benefits."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Gus, I'm intrigued by your vision...."
entries.dialogueText: "Gus, I'm intrigued by your vision. I'll seriously consider your proposal."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""I appreciate you hearing me out, M..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate you hearing me out, Mr. President. I genuinely believe this plan could work wonders for our rural folks."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""That's all I'm asking for, Mr. Pre..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's all I'm asking for, Mr. President. Just give this plan a fair shake."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Sure, Mr. President, doubts are pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure, Mr. President, doubts are part of the game. I trust you'll play the cards right for all of Sordland."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""This Workers' Rights Bill... Look,..."
entries.dialogueText: "This Workers' Rights Bill... Look, I'm all for giving hard-working folks what they deserve. But, isn't it a bit hasty to push this while we're still stuck in a recession?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""In my book, workers' rights aren't..."
entries.dialogueText: "In my book, workers' rights aren't up for negotiation, no matter the economic climate."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We've got to play this smart. We c..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've got to play this smart. We can't risk another economic blow."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Gus, I get what you're saying. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gus, I get what you're saying. But isn't it high time we put people before profits?"

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""I see where you're coming from, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see where you're coming from, Mr. President. But a prosperous economy helps everyone - the workers included."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Mr. President, I'm glad you're thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I'm glad you're thinking about the big picture. We've got to strike a balance to protect our economy and our workers."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Mr. President, I respect your stan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I respect your stance. But let's not forget about the potential fallout."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Or here's another thought - we cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or here's another thought - we could pour resources into developing crop breeds tailor-made for Gruni conditions. If it works out, we could roll this out across Sordland."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""The way I see it, short-term wins..."
entries.dialogueText: "The way I see it, short-term wins might end up costing us big time in the long run."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our talk was interrupted by a noise..."
entries.dialogueText: Our talk was interrupted by a noise coming from outside the building. We looked out the nearest window.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""But I'm telling you, if we put the..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I'm telling you, if we put the brakes on that and funnel those funds into the Gruni plan instead, we could make some real strides without spooking any potential investors."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Spectacle aside… before we sit dow..."
entries.dialogueText: "Spectacle aside… before we sit down with him, there's one more Assembly matter I wanted to raise."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On it was our next appointment, Ewa..."
entries.dialogueText: On it was our next appointment, Ewald Alphonso.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""An extravagant show of wealth, isn..."
entries.dialogueText: "An extravagant show of wealth, isn't it? Hardly seems necessary."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That kind of display plays well to..."
entries.dialogueText: "That kind of display plays well to investors... but terribly to farmers watching on state TV."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Alphonso sure knows how to make an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alphonso sure knows how to make an entrance."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""The man loves his theatrics.""
entries.dialogueText: "The man loves his theatrics."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Exactly. The optics matter. We jus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly. The optics matter. We just have to decide who we’re trying to impress."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""It's Alphonso's style, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's Alphonso's style, Mr. President. He's always enjoyed his toys."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A sleek helicopter was cutting thro..."
entries.dialogueText: A sleek helicopter was cutting through the sky, sunlight glinting off its polished surface as it descended towards us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He kept talking as he guided me int..."
entries.dialogueText: He kept talking as he guided me into the Gasom building.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Then we’re on the same page, Mr. P..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then we’re on the same page, Mr. President. Let’s make sure they feel seen for once."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Is that a helicopter or just his e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is that a helicopter or just his ego with rotor blades?"

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""He calls it branding. I call it a..."
entries.dialogueText: "He calls it branding. I call it a fuel bill with sound effects."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""If we're all sinking, nobody's win..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we're all sinking, nobody's winning."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Timing and approach are everything.""
entries.dialogueText: "Timing and approach are everything."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""There's got to be a way to improve..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's got to be a way to improve workers' rights without rocking the economic boat."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Heard a worker from Estord on the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Heard a worker from Estord on the radio. Said he's got rights on paper, but nothing in his fridge."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""That kind of thing sticks with you..."
entries.dialogueText: "That kind of thing sticks with you. Still, we’ve got to make sure the fixes don’t break something bigger."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If we overload businesses now, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we overload businesses now, they'll shrink or shut down. Workers lose more than just rights, they lose jobs."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Strong labor protections are the f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Strong labor protections are the foundation of lasting growth. A secure worker is a productive one."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let’s think of the option that sig..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let’s think of the option that signals progress without rattling the markets. We need both stability and reform."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""People don’t care about long-term..."
entries.dialogueText: "People don’t care about long-term strategy when their kids are hungry now. We fix this for them, or we lose them."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Exactly. We can’t let good intenti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly. We can’t let good intentions gut the economy."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Fair enough, but let’s roll it out..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fair enough, but let’s roll it out in stages. Rushing it could backfire."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""That’s the sweet spot. You bring t..."
entries.dialogueText: "That’s the sweet spot. You bring the idealism, I’ll help shape the rollout."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Hard to argue with that. Just make..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hard to argue with that. Just make sure we don’t promise more than the treasury can carry."
